locator: I q.10 a.1 ad 2: illud quod est vere aeternum, non solum est ens, sed vivens
interpretation: Aquinas defends Boethius' definition (De consolatione V, quoted in obj. 1: interminabilis vitae tota simul et perfecta possessio). The response gives the marks interminable (no beginning or end) and without succession (tota simul); ad 2 says the truly eternal is living, its duration attended according to operation rather than bare esse; ad 5 says tota simul removes time and perfecta excludes the imperfect now of time; ad 3 and ad 6 gloss tota as nothing lacking and possessio as firm, indeficient holding. Boethius' own text is cited through Aquinas, not separately pinned.
